strings.name: Abdel Fattah el-Sisi
strings.role: President of Egypt · Former military leader
strings.summary: A career soldier, Sisi headed military intelligence and served as defence minister before leading the military’s removal of Mohamed Morsi in 2013 and becoming president in 2014. He has pursued major infrastructure and security policies and regional diplomacy. His rule has also brought repression of dissent and shrinking political space, strongly criticized by rights groups. He won a third presidential election in 2023 and said in 2026 that his term would end in 2030.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His long leadership of Egypt and his infrastructure, security and foreign policies affect the Arab world, the Red Sea and the Mediterranean region.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.highlights.h1.title: Military and political leadership
strings.highlights.h1.text: Moved from military command and the defence ministry into the presidency, shaping Egypt’s national policies.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Graduated from the Egyptian Military Academy in 1977; later military training in Egypt, Britain and the United States.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Human rights controversy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Human Rights Watch’s 2026 report criticized his government’s repression of dissent and restrictions on civic space.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Says term ends in 2030
strings.timeline.t1.text: Said his presidential term would end in 2030; this was a stated intention, not a completed transfer.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Third presidential election win
strings.timeline.t2.text: The election authority announced his victory for a third six-year term.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Constitutional changes approved
strings.timeline.t3.text: Amendments lengthened presidential terms and allowed him to seek reelection.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Sworn in as president
strings.timeline.t4.text: First took office after resigning from the military to run for election.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Military removes Morsi
strings.timeline.t5.text: As military leader, announced the removal of elected president Mohamed Morsi.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Appointed defence minister
strings.timeline.t6.text: Morsi appointed him defence minister and commander-in-chief of the armed forces.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Graduates from military academy
strings.timeline.t7.text: Entered the infantry after graduation and advanced through command posts.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Cairo
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in El-Gamaleya, Cairo, later entering military education.
